title: 10-year growth: billionaire wealth vs. the S&P 500

source.name: Forbes World's Billionaires list and S&P 500 index levels
source.publisher: Forbes; S&P Dow Jones Indices (S&P 500 level, Jan 2015 vs Jan 2025)

notes: Forbes-tallied billionaire wealth grew from $7.1T (2015) to $16.1T (2025), about +127%. The S&P 500 index grew from about 2,028 (Jan 2015) to about 5,980 (Jan 2025), about +195%, over the same stretch. Figures approximate as publicly reported.
